name: Volunteer State Community College - Academic Transcript (two-column Courier layout)
description: Volunteer State Community College transcript. The header block holds the college address and the labels 'Record of:', 'Issued To:', 'Date Issued:', 'Date of Birth:', 'SSN:' and 'Level:'. The record is printed in two Courier columns with no dividing rule, split at x=309, and every page has a legal footer. The left column of page 1 opens with front matter: 'Course Level:', 'High School:', and 'Current Program' with Major and Maj/Concentration lines. Optional 'Events:' lines with 'Decision:/Grade:' follow. Memberships ('Member of ...') are recorded as honors and other events as academic events. Optional 'Comments:' lines and 'Degree Awarded' blocks (degrees or certificates) follow, each with Ehrs/QPts, GPA-Hrs/GPA, 'Primary Degree', Major, Maj/Concentration and 'Inst. Honors' lines. Next comes the optional 'TRANSFER CREDIT ACCEPTED BY THE INSTITUTION:' block with transfer terms headed by a date range (MM/YY-MM/YY and the school) or a season code and two-digit year followed by the school. Ranges within one year in 2000-2049 get a season and year; ranges over several years and season-code headings get no year; earlier two-digit ranges keep the school in the term name and get no season or year; single-month earlier ranges are named after the transfer heading. Transfer blocks may continue in the next column under 'Transfer Information continued:'. Then come the PRE-SYSTEM summary hours and 'INSTITUTION CREDIT:'. Institutional terms are headed '<Season> Term YYYY' (term may be lower case), and each course row (with an optional '*' remedial marker after the number and an optional R repeat code E/I; E rows are flagged as excluded from GPA) is followed by a quality-points line. Each term ends with 'Total Earned Credits', a standing line, an optional Dean's List / Honor Roll line and a TERM COMBINED block over two lines (Ehrs/GPA-H, then QPts/GPA). When a right column starts higher than usual, its first lines are overprinted on the column headings, the underscore rule and the asterisk separator (letter-interleaved text); underscores are removed from every line and dedicated rules read the overprinted TERM COMBINED block and term heading. 'TRANSCRIPT TOTALS' holds the INSTITUTION/TRANSFER/OVERALL rows and their COMBINED repeats. The last page is a 'KEY TO TRANSCRIPT' legend, which is skipped; its notes and the footer notice are added as one fixed remark at END OF TRANSCRIPT. Built from eight samples.

rules.text: VOLUNTEER STATE COMMUNITY COLLEGE is a public two-year community college and is fully accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools. R (Repeat) Grade Designation Column: E = Hours and quality points excluded in GPA; I = Hours and quality points included in GPA. CALENDAR SYSTEMS–All course work completed prior to Fall, 1988, is under the Quarter System. All course work completed after Summer, 1988, is under the Semester System. The Quality Grade Point Average is calculated by using Quality Hours and Quality Points. TRANSFER COURSES-Transfer hours are counted for degree programs but are not computed in VSCC's GPA. GOOD STANDING-Unless Otherwise noted, student is in good academic standing. Course Numbers: 040-090 or 0100-0999 Developmental or Remedial courses (Such courses do not carry credit toward a degree.); 100-199 or 1000-1999 Freshman Level; 200-299 or 2000-2999 Sophomore Level. This electronic transcript is not official without the signature of the College Registrar and should not be considered valid without the blue and red watermark behind the text. Printed copies are not official and will have the word COPY repeated on the document as a watermark.
